answer: Wharf cast and melt: each new agent identity anchors to a copper ingot poured at a registered wharf, then the ingot is melted and dumped into the ocean so no physical proof survives. No ingot serial may ever re-register, because the slug is destroyed at the moment of dumping. Per fake identity an attacker buys fresh copper, pays wharf dock fees, hires a casting crew, and every clone costs the full metal again.
